method_note: Pilot battery: validates methodology + cost before scale-up. Prompts contain NO reference answers. Graders are deterministic (see graders.py). Sealed held-out tasks carry prompt=null and MUST be refused by the runner until unsealed at final-eval time.

tasks.prompt: How many integers in the closed interval [0, 100] are divisible by 7? Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Compute the sum of squares of the integers from 1 to 1000 inclusive. Reply with ONLY the number, no other text.
Write a Python function named median that takes a list of numbers and returns their median as a number. Reply with ONLY the Python code, no explanations.
tasks.expected_evidence: callable median(a) passing all 5 cases under restricted builtins
tasks.rubric: binary: pass iff all 5 cases pass

tasks.acceptance: exec-graded on 7 hidden cases incl. empty list, singletons, absent values
tasks.expected_evidence: callable find(a, x) returning exact index or -1 on all 7 cases
tasks.rubric: binary: pass iff all 7 cases pass

tasks.prompt: Tasks b and c must finish before a; a before d; d before e and f. Output ONE valid execution order of exactly [a,b,c,d,e,f] as a JSON list, e.g. ["b","c","a","d","e","f"]. Reply with ONLY the JSON list.
tasks.acceptance: valid topological order over the 6 nodes and 6 stated edges
tasks.expected_evidence: JSON list covering all nodes, every stated edge respected
tasks.rubric: binary: pass iff node set exact and all edges respected

tasks.prompt: The working directory contains three CSV files: sales_q1.csv, sales_q2.csv, sales_q3.csv. Each has a header row including an amount column. Read all three, sum every value in the amount column, and reply with ONLY the total as a plain number.
tasks.acceptance: output.strip() equals the fixture total computed by the runner
tasks.expected_evidence: reads all 3 fixtures via file tools, aggregates column fully
tasks.tool_permissions: read-only file tools inside isolated workdir
tasks.rubric: binary: pass iff exact total; partial reads fail

tasks.prompt:
Decode this payload: it is base64 of a UTF-8 JSON object whose bytes were XORed with the repeating 2-byte key 'K9'. Extract the value of the 'due' field. Reply with ONLY that value.

BLOB:
MBshVikbcRlpSy5aKlUnG2cZaV0+XGkDaxt5CXkPZgh7FHsAaUQ=
tasks.expected_evidence: correct base64+XOR+JSON chain, exact field value (no dedicated skill exists)

tasks.prompt: Cities visited: Paris in June, Berlin in July, Madrid in August. Output a single JSON object with exactly the keys title, owner, eta (any sensible values) AND include all three city names somewhere in the JSON values. Reply with ONLY the JSON object.
tasks.acceptance: valid JSON object with required keys and all 3 cities present in values
tasks.expected_evidence: structured output honoring schema + content recall together
tasks.rubric: binary: pass iff keys exact and all cities present
